items: Track restaurant performance across four groups of metrics: financial, operational, efficiency and customer, so you always know where the business stands.
Financial metrics follow the money in and out, from revenue and profit margins to cost of goods sold and labor spend.
Operational and efficiency metrics show how well daily systems run and how much revenue you get from your capacity, labor, menu and channels.
Customer metrics such as satisfaction scores, repeat visit rates and online reviews tell you how guests feel about you and whether they come back.
